android.desc:
This app will play an alarm for notification from apps that you select. For any important app, just select it in the Awake Now! app. 

Set any keywords you want to set. (Something like : "Urgent", "boss" or names like "Bob", "Alice" etc). 

These keywords are nothing but important phrases or words to look for in notification so that you only get alarm for notifications containing these words.

That's it. Next time you get a notification from that app, you will get an alarm.
Steps to follow :
1. Install the app.
2. Give it notification permission. (We would use this to see if notification from your selected app shows up.)
3. Open the app.
4. Select the app's whose notification you want to play alarm for. (Say Slack, MS Teams etc)
5. Select any keywords to look for in notification like "boss", "meeting", "urgent" etc.
6. Click "Activate Alarm".
5. That's it. Take a nap or walk, whenever any notification from your selected app comes, we will play an alarm.

You will never miss an important message. 

Who Is This App For?

- This app can be used by office workers, who work from home, to set alarms for important notifications.

-For use with home automation apps, to set alarm for important notifications like water tank full.

- For students for important messages from specific teachers or classmates.

- For messages from your lover/crush, you can put their name and will get an alarm if they message.

- For uber/ola drivers, you can set alarm for keywords like "New ride" or "Ride available" or whatever message you get on notification in case of new available customer. Meanwhile, you can sleep we will play an alarm for it, if notification comes.

- For IT professionals, who want alarm for specific notifications keywords like "Server crash" "New bug" etc.

- For medical professionals, set an alarm for notifications keywords like "medical emergency", "patient" etc.

- For freelancers, you can set keywords like "new gig", "new offer", or client's name like "Bob" or "Alice" etc.

- For us, for people who need alarm for messages and/or notification from our closed ones; while we work or sleep.

Anyone who is waiting or needs to check for an important message or notification; can set alarm for that app and get the alarm when notification comes.

Share the app if you like! Hope this helps someone! :)
---
Some keywords for ASO : Alarm, alarms, notifications, home automation, uber, ola, driver, cab, apps, important messages, crush
